trigger: When the user requests preparation of a lesson whose selected-language attachments are omitted from the installed package.

data_sent.content: Fixed public GET paths identifying prepared assets by SHA-256 and original filename, plus ordinary connection metadata. No client files, local paths, teaching profile, answers, progress or feedback are sent.

data_returned.when: After a successful bounded download and SHA-256 verification
data_returned.content: The original prepared fictional lesson attachment bytes, written into the selected local lesson folder. No executable code is downloaded or run.

access.arrangement: Public unauthenticated HTTPS files under https://mparanza.com/static/shared/courses/clara/; host network permissions remain enforced.
controls: HTTPS and mparanza.com only, including redirects; no credentials or query parameters; passive lesson-data extensions only; 30-second request timeout and 25 MB cap; SHA-256 checked before atomic write; only selected-language attachments are fetched; no code is downloaded or executed.

retention.statement: Verified prepared files stay in the selected local lesson folder. Hosted access-log retention and other provider copies are outside this helper; no deletion schedule is enforced by the download.

security_controls.control: HTTPS and mparanza.com only, including redirects; no credentials or query parameters; passive lesson-data extensions only; 30-second request timeout and 25 MB cap; SHA-256 checked before atomic write; only selected-language attachments are fetched; no code is downloaded or executed.
